messages:
mika: Quick heads-up — routing header negotiation (x-route-policy) goes live in canary tomorrow morning. This is a compatibility risk for older SDKs that still send X-Route-Mode: explicit.

 tay: How severe? server side will accept both, right?

 mika: Server will accept both for routing, but telemetry/quotas are keyed on the new header value. Old header -> fallback quota buckets, which will mess up per-route dashboards and reserved capacity billing.

 deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] canary rollout: 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC -> 3 days

 jordan-sre: Suggestion: add a server-side shim that maps X-Route-Mode -> x-route-policy and tag telemetry as "legacy_route=true". That avoids quota loss during SDK upgrade window.

 alex-dev: Agreed. Also we should add a short-lived warning header to responses when we detect old headers so SDKs can log it.

 maria: Console note: if telemetry is tagged legacy, the per-route tile should show a badge/tooltip explaining partial attribution. Ops might otherwise open tickets.

 tay: Plan for SDKs: small patch across py/ts/go that adds the new header alongside the old one for 2 minor releases, plus an opt-out env var REDWOOD_LEGACY_ROUTE=false to disable. Log at most 1/warn per 10m per process.

 mika: Can you paste the example snippet you'll ship?

 tay: Python example:
 ```
 headers = {
   "X-Route-Mode": "explicit",
   "x-route-policy": "route:payments;source:sdk_py:v2"
 }
 ```
 TS example:
 ```
 const headers = {
   'X-Route-Mode': 'explicit',
   'x-route-policy': `route:payments;source:sdk_ts@2`
 }
 ```

 jordan-sre: I'll add the shim and a telemetry flag legacy_route=true for mapped requests. Also will emit an audit log entry when mapping happens.

 mika: Owners: tay -> SDK PRs & release notes, jordan-sre -> server shim + telemetry flag, alex-dev -> console tile copy + docs. Timeline: shim in canary today, SDK PRs today, SDK patch release tomorrow morning, monitor canary metrics for 72h, then GA.

 tay: I'll open the PRs and link them here. Will include changelog and a migration note for self-hosted customers.

 alex-dev: I'll draft console tooltip and a small dashboard alert to trigger if legacy traffic > 5% after 36h.

 mika: Thanks all. Ping here when PRs and canary are up :thumbsup:
